description: This file defines a C++ interface class IOmiProxy for interacting with an OMI (Open Management Infrastructure) proxy. It provides method declarations for mounting and unmounting crypted bundles, as well as registering and unregistering error listeners.

classes.name: omi::IOmiProxy
classes.description: Abstract interface class providing methods to interact with OMI proxy functionalities such as mounting/unmounting crypted bundles and managing error listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given container ID, file paths, and outputs the decrypted config JSON payload. Returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by container ID. Returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback that will be invoked on error events. Returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener using its tag ID.

calls: virtual bool mountCryptedBundle(const std::string&, const std::string&, const std::string&, std::string&)
virtual long unsigned registerListener(const omi::IOmiProxy::OmiErrorListener&, const void*)

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
